reason: The current goal is to give the potato stems room, and the cargo mesh looks like it could support their growth.
expectation: I expect the mesh to be fitted to the potato trough as a support, though I’m not sure exactly how.

alternatives.reason: The lettuce is ready to harvest, but the stated goal concerns the potatoes.

effect: The mesh supports the potato stems while leaving the root cover in place, and the next goal is to taste the harvest.
reaction: The supported stems and still-developing tubers make the different growth stages clear.
reason: The lettuce is ready, and cutting it is the only offered combination that advances the harvest goal.
expectation: I expect to harvest lettuce from the trough, though it may need another step before tasting.

effect: The scissors produced fresh lettuce leaves, which can now be taken to the galley.
reaction: The harvest result was straightforward; I’m curious how the first taste will be described.
reason: Using the leaves at the galley is the only offered combination and seems like the next step toward tasting them.
expectation: I expect to prepare or taste the lettuce at the galley, though I’m unsure whether another step will be needed.

effect: The galley action turned the lettuce into a fresh meal and completed the harvest goal.
reaction: The green smell against the barren view made the harvest feel significant.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making the first fresh meal was most worthwhile: the sensory detail connected the harvest to life in the cabin.

leastWorthwhile.text: Cutting the lettuce was straightforward and had little detail of its own.

surprise.text: The mesh supports the potato stems above the dark root cover while the tubers are still developing.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; the choices followed the stated goals and the available materials.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the potatoes develop and how the expedition continues.
